asked.item: Blotato Make module for pulling post analytics
another way to get analytics into Make

verdict.reason: The help pages state that the official Make module lacks analytics and describe using Make's HTTP module with the analytics endpoints and the blotato-api-key header as the alternative.

steps.text: The official Blotato Make.com module does not include analytics yet.
To pull analytics into Make, use Make's HTTP module to call the two analytics endpoints on the Analytics page.
Pass your Blotato API key in the blotato-api-key header in that HTTP module.
